content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Automated ebook

Automated ebook delivery after crypto payment is a system that verifies a buyer’s on-chain transaction and instantly delivers your digital product. It’s not a plugin or a third-party service. It’s a stack of open tools you own and control. Here’s why it matters: In Kenya, Stripe and PayPal are either unavailable or unreliable. Crypto is your only consistent option for collecting USD. But crypto payments introduce complexity—volatility, network fees, and the need for instant verification. This system removes that complexity. It converts the buyer’s crypto payment into a USD equivalent at transaction time, verifies it on-chain, and triggers file delivery automatically. You don’t need to monitor wallets or manually send files. The buyer pays, the system confirms, and the ebook lands in their inbox or download link. This is infrastructure sovereignty—you own the process from start to finish.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The system is built on four layers: payment verification, order storage, file hosting, and delivery automation. Payment verification is handled by NOWPayments. When a buyer sends crypto, NOWPayments checks the transaction on-chain and fires a webhook. This webhook triggers a backend script—either Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script—that logs the order in a database (Supabase or Google Sheets). The script then generates a secure, time-limited download link for your ebook, hosted on Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. The buyer receives this link via email, sent through a transactional email service like SendGrid or Gmail’s API. All this happens in seconds, without human intervention. The key is the webhook—it’s the signal that connects payment to delivery. No webhook, no delivery. This ensures only verified buyers get access.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This system is built for digital creators in regions where conventional payment processors are unavailable or unreliable. If you sell ebooks, courses, templates, or software and cannot use Stripe or PayPal, this is your solution. It’s also for creators who refuse to rent infrastructure. When you deploy this stack, you own it. No monthly fees. No platform lock-in. No risk of being shut down because a payment processor decides your region is too risky. It’s built for creators who prioritize sovereignty—the ability to operate independently of third-party platforms. If you’re in Kenya, Nigeria, Zimbabwe, or any region where financial isolation is a reality, this system turns crypto into a tool for global commerce. It’s not just about selling ebooks. It’s about building a business that cannot be blocked.
Own your commerce infrastructure—no subscriptions, no platform fees.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The stack is modular but interconnected. NOWPayments handles crypto payments with a 0.5% fee and supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script provide the backend logic for order processing and file delivery. Supabase or Google Sheets store order data, ensuring you have a record of every transaction. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 host your ebook files securely. Transactional email services like SendGrid or Gmail’s API deliver download links to buyers. Each component is chosen for its reliability and cost-effectiveness. Cloudflare Workers and Supabase are scalable and free for low-to-moderate usage. Google Apps Script and Sheets are free with a Google account. The system is designed to minimize costs while maximizing control. You’re not paying for infrastructure you don’t need, and you’re not dependent on any single vendor.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start with the Complete Builder Kit ($197) at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. It includes all blueprints, templates, and documentation you need to deploy this system in hours, not weeks. The kit includes step-by-step guides for setting up NOWPayments, configuring Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and integrating file hosting with Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. It also includes email templates for transactional messages and a scaling playbook for handling increased traffic. If you prefer a done-for-you solution, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) deploys the entire system in 48 hours, with 5 products loaded and end-to-end testing. Either way, you end up with a fully operational commerce stack that you own. No subscriptions. No platform fees. Just sovereign infrastructure that works anywhere.

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your payment processor: NOWPayments for crypto verification.
2. Set up backend logic: Use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle order processing.
3. Configure order storage: Use Supabase or Google Sheets to log transactions.
4. Host your files: Upload ebooks to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2.
5. Automate delivery: Integrate transactional email services like SendGrid or Gmail’s API to send download links.
6. Test end-to-end: Simulate a purchase to ensure payment verification and file delivery work seamlessly.
7. Deploy: Make your system live and start selling globally.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this system if I’m not technical?
Yes. The Complete Builder Kit includes step-by-step guides and templates. If you prefer, the Edge Commerce Stack deploys the system for you in 48 hours.
What cryptocurrencies does NOWPayments support?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT, and stablecoins on networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON for low fees.
How secure is the file delivery process?
Download links are time-limited and secured with tokens. Only verified buyers receive access, and files are hosted on encrypted storage like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2.
What happens if a buyer sends the wrong amount of crypto?
NOWPayments verifies the exact amount on-chain. If the payment is insufficient, the system does not trigger delivery, and the buyer is notified to correct the payment.
Can I scale this system for more products or higher traffic?
Yes. The Complete Builder Kit includes a scaling playbook. Cloudflare Workers and Supabase are designed for scalability, and you can add more products or upgrade hosting as needed.
